assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.description: This will be a closed-book, supervised examination. Students may bring one A4 double-sided reference sheet, which may be handwritten, printed, or a combination of both. The Final Exam is a hurdle requirement.

assessments.name: Oral/Viva based Evaluation
assessments.description: Viva will be conducted during tutorial session in week 8. It will be based on the topics discussed in the first 7 weeks lectures/tutorials. More details will be provided on the canvas website. The Oral/Viva is a hurdle requirement.

assessments.name: Early Semester Feedback Task
assessments.description: This is an individual, auto-graded quiz that includes multiple choice questions. It will be based on the contents covered from Week 1 to Week 3.

assessments.name: Team Report
